name: MeasureTheory.Measure.prod
type: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → [MeasurableSpace α] → [MeasurableSpace β] → MeasureTheory.Measure α → MeasureTheory.Measure β → MeasureTheory.Measure (α × β)
